title: Efficacy of Lutein, Zeaxanthine and Trypan Blue to Stain the Anterior Lens Capsule
brief_summary: Effectiveness of lutein, zeaxanthin and trypan blue to stain the anterior lens capsule during cataract phacoemulsification.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

* Patients over 50 years
* Diagnosis of cataract (nuclear, entumecente, total)
* Absence of red reflex
* Indication of cataract surgery

Exclusion Criteria

* Posterior subcapsular cataract
* Any history of eye disease
* Glaucoma
* Eye infection affecting any structure prior ocular
* Any previous ocular surgery
